svg.title: If uniform convergence failed, choose violating configurations on a bad subsequence and arbitrary ones elsewhere, contradicting (HL1). Uniform tails then give convergence of summed profiles by finite-head/tail splitting. The lift retains fixed input ingredients, wing/address supports and com- mon shelves. Recovery preserves exact ingredient equality and the paid majorant, transporting (HL1) and its uniform consequence without mask continuity.
